In the same Workbook A export, Drive_Import_Log Status values show 20 of 43 logged run entries as Held with publication failed and rollback incomplete due to protected-cell errors. This record therefore proves the implemented backup/restore mechanism and a recorded held import (IMP_001), but does not establish that backup-and-restore consistently completes successfully in practice. The 20/43 figure is a log reliability count from Drive_Import_Log, not a business-performance metric.
